name: Newfoundland (1904–1949)
description: A British Red Ensign — red with the Union Flag in the canton — charged in the fly with the Newfoundland badge: within a wreath and belt, Mercury presenting a kneeling fisherman offering his catch to Britannia, above the motto 'Terra Nova'.
history: The Newfoundland badge was granted in 1904 and its use on the Red Ensign approved by the Admiralty in 1918. The Dominion's National Flag Act of 1931 made the Union Jack the national flag but defined the Red Ensign as the colony's 'national colours' for use at sea, so the ensign served as Newfoundland's distinctive flag until confederation with Canada on 31 March 1949; a Blue Ensign with the same badge was the government flag.

features.role: Newfoundland badge with Mercury, fisherman and Britannia
